description: Read a task's consensus/agreement state: required label count, methodology, agreement score, resolution status (incl. winningSubmissionId), the (anonymized) submissions in the consensus group, and truthInference — the same reliability-weighted Dawid–Skene aggregate the review UI shows (identity-safe 'Annotator N' labels). Requires open-label:read scope; contract reviewers read within their assignment scope.
name: open_label_task_consensus
